Sparkline

Source: R/mini-charts.R
shad_sparkline.Rd

A tiny inline chart with no axes, no labels and no plotting stack: one SVG path (or a row of bars) that stretches to fill its container. Built for shad_value_box()'s sparkline slot, a table cell, or an item row.

Usage

shad_sparkline(
  values,
  type = c("line", "area", "bar", "step"),
  color = 1,
  width = "100%",
  height = "2.5rem",
  stroke_width = 2,
  fill_opacity = 0.18,
  baseline = NULL,
  label = NULL,
  class = NULL,
  ...
)

Arguments

values

A numeric vector.

type

"line" (default), "area", "bar", or "step".

color

Chart-token index 1–5 (default 1), or any CSS colour.

width, height

CSS dimensions of the drawing box. Height defaults to "2.5rem"; width to "100%", so it fills whatever it is dropped into.

stroke_width

Line thickness in px (line/step/area outline).

fill_opacity

Opacity of the area fill / bars.

baseline

For "bar", draw bars from zero when the data crosses it. NULL (default) picks automatically: zero-anchored if any value is negative, otherwise bars grow from the floor.

label

Accessible name. When NULL (default) the chart is decorative and hidden from assistive technology — correct when the number it illustrates is already on screen.

class

Extra CSS classes.

...

Extra attributes for the root <svg>.

Value

An SVG tag.

Details

Marks are painted with the theme's chart tokens, so dark mode and preset switches restyle them in CSS — nothing re-renders, and no Shiny session is involved. Non-finite values (NA, NaN, Inf) break the series into separate runs rather than being interpolated across.

See also

shad_mini_donut(), shad_value_box()

Other shadshiny dashboard: shad_chart_container(), shad_mini_donut(), shad_timeline(), shad_timeline_item(), shad_value_box()

Examples

shad_sparkline(c(3, 5, 4, 8, 7, 12, 11))
#> <svg class="shad-sparkline" viewBox="0 0 100 100" preserveAspectRatio="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" style="width:100%;height:2.5rem;" aria-hidden="true">
#>   <path d="M0 98L16.67 76.67L33.33 87.33L50 44.67L66.67 55.33L83.33 2L100 12.67" fill="none" stroke="var(--shad-chart-1)" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" vector-effect="non-scaling-stroke"></path>
#> </svg>
shad_sparkline(c(-2, 1, 3, -1, 4), type = "bar", color = 2)
#> <svg class="shad-sparkline" viewBox="0 0 100 100" preserveAspectRatio="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" style="width:100%;height:2.5rem;" aria-hidden="true">
#>   <rect x="1" width="18" y="66.67" height="33.33" fill="var(--shad-chart-2)" fill-opacity="0.18" rx="1.5"></rect>
#>   <rect x="21" width="18" y="50" height="16.67" fill="var(--shad-chart-2)" fill-opacity="0.18" rx="1.5"></rect>
#>   <rect x="41" width="18" y="16.67" height="50" fill="var(--shad-chart-2)" fill-opacity="0.18" rx="1.5"></rect>
#>   <rect x="61" width="18" y="66.67" height="16.67" fill="var(--shad-chart-2)" fill-opacity="0.18" rx="1.5"></rect>
#>   <rect x="81" width="18" y="0" height="66.67" fill="var(--shad-chart-2)" fill-opacity="0.18" rx="1.5"></rect>
#> </svg>
